queries.query: large language models "network configuration" generation OR synthesis OR "intent-to-configuration"
queries.rationale: Find literature where LLMs are directly used to generate network configs or translate natural-language intent into configurations (core phenomenon).

queries.query: LLM OR "large language model" "network operations" OR NetOps OR AIOps
queries.rationale: Broader NetOps/AIOps work that applies LLMs to operational tasks, instrumenting scope and common use-cases.
Target architectures combining generation with validators/repair loops — directly relevant to mitigations and method patterns.

queries.query: Batfish OR Veriflow OR NetPlumber OR "network configuration verification" formal verification networks
queries.rationale: Locate deterministic/ formal validators and verification engines used in NetOps to validate reachability, policy compliance, loops — essential baseline validators.

queries.query: benchmarks "LLM for networking" OR "AIOps benchmark" "NetOps benchmark" "TSNBench" "6G-Bench" "OpsEval" "OWL"
queries.rationale: Survey existing benchmarks and datasets used to evaluate LLMs/AIOps in networking; crucial for assessing benchmark validity and gaps.
Collect literature on hallucination/failure taxonomy for LLM outputs in operational tasks to characterize phenomena and failure modes.
Identify security/adversarial mechanisms affecting agentic LLMs and prompts in operational contexts (threats to safety and integrity).

queries.query: constrained generation DSL schema "network config" "domain-specific language" "structured prompting"
queries.rationale: Find approaches that constrain LLM outputs via DSLs, schemas, or structured prompts to reduce invalid or unsafe outputs (mitigations).
Literature on model calibration and confidence estimation for LLM outputs, relevant for deciding when to accept/refuse LLM-suggested NetOps changes.
Search work on LLMs using external tools (function calls, validators, simulators) for grounded or executable outputs in NetOps workflows (mechanism/mitigation).
source_preferences: platform docs (OpenAI, Anthropic) for function calling

queries.rationale: Find operational metrics and empirical methods used to evaluate correctness of generated configurations (construct validity and metrics).
Locate literature on agentic/closed-loop systems applied to NetOps to position study in neighbouring agent research and governance challenges.
Discover studies comparing automated LLM outputs with human operator workflows and approval mechanisms (operational mitigations and practical constraints).

queries.query: datasets "network configuration" public corpus OR "network policies" dataset OR topology dataset
queries.rationale: Search for public datasets, corpora, or synthetic generators for configs/policies/topologies to support reproducible experiments.

queries.query: evaluation pitfalls "benchmark validity" "task mismatch" "distribution shift" LLM evaluation
queries.rationale: Collect meta-work on benchmark validity, distributional gaps, and pitfalls when applying LLM benchmarks to operational tasks (benchmark validity).

queries.query: related network automation tooling Ansible Nornir SaltStack Netmiko integration with LLM OR GPT
queries.rationale: Survey how existing automation/orchestration tooling is integrated with LLMs or programmatic interfaces — practical neighbouring engineering work.

queries.query: legal regulatory guidance "autonomous systems" "operational safety" AI governance NIST EU AI Act
queries.rationale: Collect governance, safety, and compliance literature guiding deployment of autonomous operational AI agents (threats to deployment and disclosure requirements).
Locate specific methods for automated detection and repair of misconfigured network elements, including programmatic repair informed by models or rules.

queries.query: case studies "LLM in production" OR "LLM in operations" "network" "incidents"
queries.rationale: Find operational case studies, incident reports, or postmortems where LLM/automation impacted network operations (empirical failure evidence and realism).

inclusion_criteria: Peer‑reviewed conference and journal papers, arXiv/tech reports, and workshop papers addressing LLMs, NetOps, or both;
Tool and verifier primary publications (Batfish, Veriflow, NetPlumber) and their technical reports;
Benchmarks, datasets, and public code repositories with reproducible artifacts;
Policy, safety, and governance documents relevant to operational AI deployment;
Empirical studies, case studies, or incident reports that report measurable operational effects or failure modes.
Public internet-available resources (RFCs, vendor technical docs) with technical substance.
exclusion_criteria: Pure marketing material, high-level blog posts without technical detail, or vendor whitepapers lacking reproducible methods;
Papers outside the intersection of LLM/Generative AI and network operations unless they provide directly transferable methods (e.g., general LLM safety only if method is applicable);
Works older than 2010 unless canonical/seminal for network verification (e.g., original formal-methods papers) — treat pre-2010 as historical background only;
Non-technical opinion pieces or editorials that lack empirical or methodological content.
date_rationale: Prioritise 2020–2026 literature to capture the LLM era and recent NetOps-AIOps/benchmark work while allowing earlier seminal verification and formal-methods papers (2010 onward) for foundational context. Include the very latest preprints (arXiv/technical reports) through August 2026 to ensure up-to-date coverage.
